summary: The diff successfully implements all requested requirements. A 3D rotating background using React Three Fiber has been added to the LoginScreen, with continuous camera animation, abstract geometric shapes, theme-aware colors derived from OKLCH variables, and performance optimizations. All acceptance criteria are met.
